<thought>The observed isotopic envelope matches the binomial distribution expected for ~19 carbon atoms (M+1 ≈ 20 %, M+2 ≈ 2 %, etc.). No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
